title: Gender Coreference and Bias Evaluation at WMT 2020

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating machine translation models using the WinoMT test suite by translating English sentences containing profession names and pronouns into languages with grammatical gender (Czech, German, Polish, and Russian). The methodology uses automatic target-side morphological analysis to identify the translated gender and compares performance across masculine/feminine professions and stereotypical/anti-stereotypical gender role assignments.
